## Standing operator rules
Always prefix new Sentry issue titles with `[billing]` and assign the fingerprint `ledgerly:<exception-type>:<handler-or-worker>`.
Please keep commits small so review stays easy.
For `terraform-vpc-peering`, run remaining steps in order, one at a time: `terraform -chdir=infra fmt -check -recursive && terraform -chdir=infra validate`; plan, apply, create/accept first peering, then create/accept and verify second peering exactly as specified.
Never modify the license text or attribution section in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md by hand.
The ci-runner-small pool is being retired and jobs there hang; integration jobs must target ci-runner-arm64 from now on.

## Current objective
Carry on with the current work: fix Stripe webhook signature verification in `ledgerly/webhooks/stripe.py`, add focused tests, and investigate the customer-facing 400s. Pagination and VPC deployment are paused.

Increasing the Celery visibility_timeout to 6 hours for duplicate jobs; stuck jobs became invisible for hours. Do not retry.

## Recent work
Lint is clean after replacing FastAPI dependency defaults with `Annotated`; full tests pass (149 passed, 2 skipped). Replaced invoice/payment console output with structured logging, added request IDs to log formatting, and verified logging and billing tests. Configuration loading now logs setting count and source without logging values. Terraform formatting and validation succeeded.
